e.title: 保单问答 RAG：把四次检索未命中留在评测里，并修正一个曾虚高自身指标的 nDCG 实现
e.title_en: Policy-document RAG that keeps its four retrieval misses in the evaluation, and fixed an nDCG implementation that had been inflating its own metrics
e.title_hk: 保單問答 RAG：把四次檢索未命中留在評測裡，並修正一個曾虛高自身指標的 nDCG 實現
e.summary: 一个面向复杂保单文档的检索增强问答系统：混合稠密（BGE-M3）与稀疏（BM25）检索并做倒数排名融合、加一层重排，再用结构化输出回答，答案附状态、引证、条件、限制与来源页码；其评测刻意保留四个前十候选未命中的查询，并明确「评测应当暴露弱点，而不是被优化到每个用例都消失」，另在第二阶段加固中修正了会让同一黄金页的多个分块重复计分的 nDCG 实现
e.summary_hk: 一個面向複雜保單文檔的檢索增強問答系統：混合稠密（BGE-M3）與稀疏（BM25）檢索並做倒數排名融合、加一層重排，再用結構化輸出回答，答案附狀態、引證、條件、限制與來源頁碼；其評測刻意保留四個前十候選未命中的查詢，並明確「評測應當暴露弱點，而不是被優化到每個用例都消失」，另在第二階段加固中修正了會讓同一黃金頁的多個分塊重複計分的 nDCG 實現
e.summary_en: A retrieval-augmented question answering system for complex policy documents: it fuses dense (BGE-M3) and sparse (BM25) retrieval with reciprocal rank fusion, adds a reranking stage and answers in a structured form carrying status, citations, conditions, limitations and source page numbers; its evaluation deliberately retains four queries that miss the top-ten candidates, stating that evaluation should reveal weaknesses rather than be optimised until every test case disappears, and during Phase-2 hardening it corrected an nDCG implementation that was giving duplicate credit to multiple chunks from the same golden page
e.body:
**Insurance-Rag-Assistant** 是一个**面向复杂保单文档的检索增强问答系统**（仓库 `Swapnadip-DataScientist/Insurance-Rag-Assistant`），**实测 ★0、fork 0、主语言 Python、仓库体量 12,882 KB、**创建于 2026-08-28、最后推送于 2026-09-10****（**均 GitHub API 实测值**；**⚠️ 注意：其**创建日**在本轮解冻窗口之前，但**推送日**落在窗口内——按本轮目标「pushed/created > 2026-09-05」的口径，它以**推送**入窗**）；**实测 topics 13 项**：**`bge-m3`、`bm25`、`chunking`、`docker`、`fastapi`、`genai`、**`insurance`**、`llm`、`python`、`qdrant`、`rag`、**`reinsurance`**、`reranking`**；**⚠️ 该仓库实测无任何许可文件（`LICENSE` 于 main 分支实测 404）**、**README 全文未作许可声明**；**README 实测 47,543 字节**（**本批最长**）。**已实测存在的关键文件**：**`requirements.txt`（HTTP 200）**。本条目属于本轮主题**「把边界写成清单」**中的**第二种，也是把「失败项」**放在结果里**最彻底的一种**。

可核实信息（**均 README 逐字实测**）：⭐⭐⭐ **其开篇核心原则逐字，是本条目最重要的一句**：**「**The LLM is only one component.** **The difficult engineering work is making sure the right insurance evidence reaches the model, in the right order, with enough controls to explain why the final answer should be trusted.**」**——**即「大模型只是其中一个组件。真正困难的工程工作是**确保正确的保险证据以正确的顺序到达模型，并有足够的控制来**解释为什么最终答案应当被信任****」**。

对 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **「评测应当暴露弱点，而不是被优化到每个用例都消失」是本条目乃至本轮主题最锋利的一句**——**其上下文逐字为**：**「The final evaluation still contains **four Top-10 candidate retrieval misses**: `Q002`、`Q005`、`Q007`、`Q009`. **These are intentionally retained as documented residual failures rather than tuning repeatedly against a small benchmark until it reaches an artificial 100% score.** This is an important engineering principle: **evaluation should reveal weaknesses, not be optimized until every test case disappears.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **三点值得单独记**：**① 它把未命中的**四个查询编号**写进了文档**（`Q002`／`Q005`／`Q007`／`Q009`）——**即**哪些用例失败是可查的，而不是一个通过率****；**② 它给出**为何保留**的理由**（**反复对着小基准调参直到 100% 是一种人为结果**）；**③ 它把这件事上升为一条**工程原则****。**对做模型评测的学生，这与第 332 轮 [[insurance-fraud-risk-scoring]] 把 PR-AUC 1.00 定性为 bug 报告属**同一枚硬币的两面**：**一条拒绝让分数**虚高**，一条拒绝让分数**假装完美****（**另可与第 331 轮 [[aida-tix-anomaly-detection]] 的 AUC 0.46 并读**——**三条分别在**过高、过低与残缺**三处守住同一条纪律**）。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **「修正了一个曾虚高自身指标的 nDCG 实现」是本条目在度量诚信上最值得记的一处**——**逐字为**：**「During Phase-2 hardening, the nDCG implementation was **corrected so multiple chunks from the same golden page do not receive duplicate relevance credit**. **Standard normalized DCG is now kept within the expected 0–1 range.** The same correction **prevents multiple chunks from the same golden source from artificially inflating Precision@K**.」**⭐⭐ **即**同一页被切成多个分块时会重复获得相关性得分**，**使指标**人为偏高****；**作者在第二阶段加固中发现并修正了它**，**并同时把 nDCG 收回到应有的 0–1 区间**（**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**修正后的实现已无其他问题**——**本次未读其评测代码**）。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **「一条与直觉相反的延迟结论」是本条目在工程方法上最值得记的一处**——**逐字为**：**「**Without instrumentation, an 80–130 second request could incorrectly be blamed on hybrid retrieval.** With stage metrics, one observed cold request was: Retrieval : 13.85 s；Reranking : 19.86 s；**Generation : 81.12 s**；Total : 114.83 s」**，**其结论逐字为**：**「**The main cold-start bottleneck is the generation model / Ollama path, followed by reranker/model initialization. Hybrid retrieval itself is not responsible for the majority of the observed end-to-end latency.** This investigation also demonstrated why **performance problems should be isolated by stage instead of guessed from UI response time**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **这与第 330 轮 [[claim-to-confidence]] 的「What is real」、第 333 轮 [[aero-audit]] 的「用注入攻击测自己」同属**用测量取代猜测**；**其价值在于**结论与最自然的猜测相反**——**混合检索是最显眼的复杂部件，却**不是**瓶颈****（**warning：本词条**不主张**在别的机器或模型上瓶颈仍是生成**——**其自述为本地 CPU 开发环境**）。**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **「答案不是只有一个，而是带状态」是本条目在输出设计上最值得记的一点**——**其结构化响应逐字含**：**`answer_status`（**示例值为 `covered`**）、`answer`、`citations`、`conditions`、`limitations`、`sources`（每项含 **`citation_id`、`document_id`、`page_number`、`page_chunk_index`**）**，**另有分阶段耗时**（`retrieval_ms`、`rerank_ms`、`generation_ms`、`total_ms`、`latency_ms`）**；**并逐字说明**：**「**The expected output is not just an answer.** It also includes the **answer status, citations, conditions, limitations and source provenance**.」**，**以及**：**「**This makes the answer inspectable rather than treating the LLM as a black box.**」**⭐⭐ **其第 13 节的示例显示**状态取值含 `conditional`（条件承保）**——**即系统可以回答「视条件而定」而非只答「保」或「不保」**（**可与本轮 [[restaurant-insurance-quote]] 的四种报价状态、第 333 轮 [[claimlens]] 的弃权状态并读**——**三条都在把**二值判断**展开成多值状态**）。**⑤ ⭐⭐⭐ **其六个示例业务问题逐字实测，且都是真实保单语义**：**「Will **Aviva** replace a fitted child seat after an accident even if there is no visible damage?」**（**车险：事故后儿童座椅是否更换，即使无明显损坏**）；**「Is damage caused by normal wear and tear covered by a repair guarantee?」**（**正常磨损是否属维修保证范围**）；**「Will a motor insurer recover an electric vehicle if its battery runs out of charge?」**（**电动车电量耗尽是否属救援范围**）；**「What are the Policy Type and Stream Name for policy ID `92010664`?」**（**精确保单编号查询**）；**「When must premium and commission be paid under a reinsurance agreement?」**（**再保协议下的保费与佣金支付时点**）；**「What compensation percentage applies to a specific injury listed in a policy table?」**（**保单表格中特定伤残的赔付比例**）**⭐⭐⭐ **对做保险文档问答的学生，这六问本身就是一份**测试集设计范例**：**四条考语义（磨损、电量、儿童座椅、再保支付），一条考**精确编号检索**，一条考**表格取值****——**恰好覆盖其自述的两类检索弱点**。**⑥ ⭐⭐⭐ **「为什么要混合检索」的论证逐字，且把两类检索的失效方式写得很具体**——**其文档类型逐字含**：**「long contractual wording, **exclusions and conditional clauses**, **tables and schedules**, **policy identifiers and exact reference numbers**, **similar clauses with materially different meanings**, scanned or low-quality pages, domain-specific terminology across **Motor, Travel, Home, Marine and Reinsurance** documents」**；**并逐字给出两类检索各自的失效面**：**「A normal keyword search may **miss semantically similar wording**. A dense-vector search may **understand meaning but fail on exact policy IDs, codes or table values**.」**⭐⭐ **「语义相似但措辞不同」与「措辞相同但含义实质不同」同时被列为难点**——**后者是保单文本的特有风险**（**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**混合检索能完全解决这两类问题**——**其自述仍有四个未命中**）。**⑦ ⭐⭐⭐ **其拒答与保守生成的行为被单列为评测情景，是本轮主题的又一处落点**——**第 13 节「生成评测」逐字列出三条示例**：**「Example — successful retrieval」**、**「**Example — retrieval failure propagating downstream**」**、**「**Example — conservative generation under missing evidence**」**⭐⭐ **「检索失败如何向下游传播」被作为一个**评测情景**而非事故**——**即它把**错误如何传导**也纳入了被观测范围**；**其生成评测独立于检索评测**，**检查项逐字为**：**「answer-status correctness, groundedness, answer correctness, citation correctness, **unsupported claims**, **hallucination-free behavior」**（**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**其结果达到任何水平**——**本次未运行**）。**⑧ ⭐⭐ **文档摄取与分块策略逐字，且给出**分阶段**做法**：**摄取含「Native extraction first（原生抽取优先）」「Table-aware extraction（表格感知抽取）」「Selective OCR strategy（选择性 OCR 策略）」与「Phase-2 corpus」**；**分块含「Phase 1 — generic narrative chunking」与「**Phase 2 — structure-aware chunking（结构感知分块）**」**⭐⭐ **「原生抽取优先、表格单独处理、OCR 仅在必要时」这一顺序**，**与第 329 轮 [[reinsurance-treaty-agent]] 的「正则优先、LLM 兜底」是同一种**由廉价确定方法向昂贵方法递进**的结构**。**⑨ ⭐⭐ **其负载测试表逐字实测，且包含了**对自己不利**的一行**：**「1 concurrent / 1 request：mean **116.38 s**，吞吐 **0.0086 req/s**」**；**「1 concurrent / 4 requests：mean **65.69 s**，p50 63.63 s，p95 90.94 s，**0.0152 req/s**」**；**「4 concurrent / 10 requests：mean **201.40 s**，p50 **236.95 s**，p95 **249.85 s**，0.0165 req/s」**⭐⭐ **即**并发升到 4 时平均与 p95 延迟显著恶化**（**mean 从 116 s 升到 201 s**）**——**这一行若不写，读者会以为并发更好**；**且其对「1 concurrent / 4 requests 反而更快」也**未作掩饰性解释****（**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**该表可外推到其他硬件**）。**⑩ ⭐⭐ **服务接口与健康检查逐字**：**FastAPI 服务含 `/ask`、`/health/live`、`/health/ready`，并单列一节「Blocking ML work（阻塞式机器学习工作）」**——⭐ **把「机器学习推理会阻塞事件循环」单列成节，说明作者意识到该架构的并发瓶颈所在**（**⚠️ 本词条**未读该节正文**）。**⑪ ⭐ 可与本站 RAG 与保单文档条目并读**：[[clauseguard]]、[[policy-explainer-ai]]、[[rag-assurance]]、[[valact-rag]]、[[sfcr-mistral-extraction]]、[[chinese-insurance-doc-parsing]]、[[insurance-multi-agent-langgraph]]、[[mongodb-insurance-pdf-search]]、[[insurance-qa-en]]、[[insuranceqa-original]]、[[reinsurance-contracts-repository]]。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**① ⚠️ 许可情形**：**GitHub API 许可字段实测为 `NONE`**，**`LICENSE` 于 main 分支实测 404**，**且 README 全文**未作任何许可声明****。**未声明许可即意味着**默认保留全部权利**，**使用、修改或再分发其代码前必须自行确认授权状况**（**本条属「完全未声明」一类，与同轮 [[restaurant-insurance-quote]] 的**明确声明无许可**及第 332 轮多条「声称而无文件」不同**）；**②** 本次核实的是**仓库元数据、topics（13 项）、README（47,543 字节）全文的开篇核心原则、业务问题与六个示例问题、结构化响应示例、架构图、混合检索与重排两节、文档摄取与分块策略两节、检索评测三小节（含四个未命中）、评测指标说明（含 nDCG 修正）、生成评测三示例、可观测性与延迟（含最终结论与负载表）、FastAPI 服务与端点清单**，**并以 raw 探测确认 `requirements.txt` 存在（HTTP 200）与 `LICENSE` 不存在（404）**，⭐⭐ **但**未克隆、未安装、未运行其 RAG 或评测、未启动 FastAPI 服务、未读 `src/` 下任何源码、未读 `requirements.txt` 内容、未查看其任何查询输出或评测报告、未读 README 第 15 节「Blocking ML work」正文****，因此**不能转述其检索实现、重排模型、分块参数、向量库配置、生成提示词或任何实际指标数值**；**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **未核实**其「四个 Top-10 未命中被刻意保留」的说法**，**亦未核实**其命中率、召回率、精确率、MRR 或 nDCG 的**任何具体数值****（**README 第 11 节含评测表，**本次只读到其文字结论与四个查询编号**）；**本词条**不主张**其检索质量达到任何水平**；**这是本条目最需要后续核实的一处**；**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **未核实**其 nDCG 修正确实解决了重复计分问题**——**本词条只核实在 README 中被如此描述**；**⚠️ 此类「指标实现本身曾虚高」的情形在本会话已出现两次（另一次为第 332 轮 [[insurance-fraud-risk-scoring]] 的 PR-AUC 1.00）**，**都属作者**主动披露**；**⑤ ⭐⭐⭐ **未核实**其「瓶颈是生成而非混合检索」这一结论**——**本次未做任何性能测量**；**其自述环境为**本地 CPU**（**且提到 Ollama 路径**），**故该结论**不主张**可外推到其他硬件或部署形态**；**⑥ ⭐⭐ **未核实**其六个示例问题是否真在其语料中可回答**，**亦未核实**其示例响应中的 `answer_status` 取值域（**本次只见到 `covered` 与 `conditional` 两个值**）；**⑦ ⭐⭐ **未核实**其使用**Aviva**这一真实保险公司名称的方式**（**示例问题中出现**）**——**本词条**不主张**其与 Aviva 存在任何关系、授权或数据来源**；**⑧ ⭐⭐ **未核实**其语料的来源与合法性**——**README 提到 Motor、Travel、Home、Marine 与 Reinsurance 文档及一份具体保单编号**，**但**未说明这些文档是公开、脱敏还是客户资料****；**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**其语料的使用在法律或合同上无风险**（**本次未评估**）；**⑨ ⭐ ⚠️ **该项目自述为「production-oriented」****，**但**其自述的延迟为**每请求 20–115 秒（本地 CPU）**、吞吐为**0.0086–0.0165 请求/秒****，**且其负载测试显示并发升高时延迟恶化**；**本词条据此**不主张**其可用于任何真实的生产问答服务或客户-facing 场景**；**⑩ ⭐ ⚠️ **保险条款问答的结果若被用于理赔或承保判断，在多数辖区涉及**受监管的业务动作****；**本词条**不主张**其输出可用于任何真实的理赔决定、承保判断、法律意见或客户答复**；**⑪ ⭐ ★0、fork 0、创建于 2026-08-28、推送于 2026-09-10**，**关注度极低**，**不主张其成熟度、正确性或已被采用**；**⑫ ⭐ 其 topics 含 `insurance`、`reinsurance`、`rag`、`qdrant`、`bge-m3`、`bm25`、`reranking` 等 13 项**，**与其内容一致**；**⑬ 是否有中文材料本次未核实**（**README 实测为英文**）。**核实说明**：`https://api.github.com/repos/Swapnadip-DataScientist/Insurance-Rag-Assistant` 于 2026-09-11 经 GitHub API 实测读取（含许可字段、★数、语言、体量、创建／推送时间与 13 项 topics）；README 47,543 字节经 `raw.githubusercontent.com` 实测逐字核对；**`LICENSE` 经 raw 实测 404、`requirements.txt` 实测 200**；**未克隆、未安装、未运行、未读源码与评测报告**。

可核實資訊（**均 README 逐字實測**）：⭐⭐⭐ **開篇核心原則逐字**：**「**The LLM is only one component.** **The difficult engineering work is making sure the right insurance evidence reaches the model, in the right order, with enough controls to explain why the final answer should be trusted.**」**。

**Insurance-Rag-Assistant** is **a retrieval-augmented question answering system for complex policy documents** (repository `Swapnadip-DataScientist/Insurance-Rag-Assistant`), with **measured ★0, 0 forks, Python as the primary language, a 12,882 KB repository, created 2026-08-28 and last pushed 2026-09-10** (**all GitHub API measurements**; **⚠️ note that its creation date precedes this round’s thaw window while its push date falls inside it — under the objective’s "pushed/created > 2026-09-05" wording it enters on the push**); **thirteen topics measurably present** including **`insurance`**, **`reinsurance`**, `rag`, `qdrant`, `bge-m3`, `bm25`, `reranking`, `fastapi`, `docker`, `llm`, `genai`, `chunking` and `python`; **⚠️ the repository measurably has no licence file (`LICENSE` measured 404 on main) and its README makes no licence statement**; **the README measures 47,543 bytes, the longest in this batch**. **Key files measurably present**: **`requirements.txt` (HTTP 200)**. It is the second of this round’s four takes on **writing the boundary as a list**, **and the most thorough in putting its failures into the result**.

Verifiable details (**all read verbatim from the README**): ⭐⭐⭐ **its opening core principle reads verbatim**: **"The LLM is only one component. The difficult engineering work is making sure the right insurance evidence reaches the model, in the right order, with enough controls to explain why the final answer should be trusted."**

For RIAA: **① ⭐⭐⭐ "Evaluation should reveal weaknesses, not be optimized until every test case disappears" is the sharpest line of this round’s theme** — its context reads verbatim: **"The final evaluation still contains four Top-10 candidate retrieval misses: `Q002`, `Q005`, `Q007`, `Q009`. These are intentionally retained as documented residual failures rather than tuning repeatedly against a small benchmark until it reaches an artificial 100% score. This is an important engineering principle: evaluation should reveal weaknesses, not be optimized until every test case disappears."** ⭐⭐⭐ **Three points deserve separate note**: **the four missing queries are written into the document by ID, so which cases fail is checkable rather than reduced to a pass rate**; **the reason for keeping them is stated — repeatedly tuning against a small benchmark until it reads 100% is an artificial result**; **and it is elevated to an engineering principle**. **It is the other side of the same coin as round 332’s [[insurance-fraud-risk-scoring]] calling a PR-AUC of 1.00 a bug report — one refuses a score that is inflated, the other refuses a score that pretends to be perfect** (**and both can be read with round 331’s [[aida-tix-anomaly-detection]] and its AUC of 0.46 — three entries holding one discipline at the too-high, too-low and incomplete ends**). **② ⭐⭐⭐ Correcting an nDCG implementation that had been inflating its own metrics is the entry’s most notable piece of measurement integrity** — verbatim: **"During Phase-2 hardening, the nDCG implementation was corrected so multiple chunks from the same golden page do not receive duplicate relevance credit. Standard normalized DCG is now kept within the expected 0–1 range. The same correction prevents multiple chunks from the same golden source from artificially inflating Precision@K."** ⭐⭐ **That is, several chunks cut from the same page were each receiving relevance credit, biasing the metrics upward; the author found and fixed it during Phase-2 hardening and brought nDCG back into the expected 0–1 range** (**⚠️ the evaluation code was not read, so the entry does not claim the corrected implementation is free of other issues**). **③ ⭐⭐⭐ A latency conclusion that contradicts the obvious guess is the entry’s most notable piece of engineering method** — verbatim: **"Without instrumentation, an 80–130 second request could incorrectly be blamed on hybrid retrieval. With stage metrics, one observed cold request was: Retrieval 13.85 s; Reranking 19.86 s; Generation 81.12 s; Total 114.83 s"**, **with the conclusion verbatim**: **"The main cold-start bottleneck is the generation model / Ollama path, followed by reranker/model initialization. Hybrid retrieval itself is not responsible for the majority of the observed end-to-end latency. This investigation also demonstrated why performance problems should be isolated by stage instead of guessed from UI response time."** ⭐⭐⭐ **This belongs with round 330’s [[claim-to-confidence]] "What is real" section and round 333’s [[aero-audit]] measuring itself with injected attacks — measurement replacing guesswork — and its value lies in the conclusion running against the most natural guess: hybrid retrieval is the most conspicuous complex component, yet it is not the bottleneck** (**⚠️ the entry does not claim generation remains the bottleneck on other hardware or models — the author describes a local CPU environment**). **④ ⭐⭐⭐ "The answer is not a single value but carries a status" is the entry’s most notable output design point** — **its structured response contains verbatim `answer_status` (example value `covered`), `answer`, `citations`, `conditions`, `limitations`, `sources` (each with `citation_id`, `document_id`, `page_number` and `page_chunk_index`) plus stage timings**, **and it states verbatim**: **"The expected output is not just an answer. It also includes the answer status, citations, conditions, limitations and source provenance."**, **and**: **"This makes the answer inspectable rather than treating the LLM as a black box."** ⭐⭐ **Its section 13 examples show a status value of `conditional`** — **the system can answer "it depends on conditions" rather than only yes or no** (**readable with this round’s four quote states in [[restaurant-insurance-quote]] and round 333’s abstention states in [[claimlens]] — all three expand a binary judgement into multiple states**). **⑤ ⭐⭐⭐ Its six example business questions read verbatim and are genuinely policy-semantic**: **"Will Aviva replace a fitted child seat after an accident even if there is no visible damage?"**; **"Is damage caused by normal wear and tear covered by a repair guarantee?"**; **"Will a motor insurer recover an electric vehicle if its battery runs out of charge?"**; **"What are the Policy Type and Stream Name for policy ID `92010664`?"**; **"When must premium and commission be paid under a reinsurance agreement?"**; **"What compensation percentage applies to a specific injury listed in a policy table?"** ⭐⭐⭐ **For students building policy-document QA, those six questions are themselves a test-set design template: four test semantics (wear and tear, battery charge, child seat, reinsurance payment), one tests exact-identifier retrieval and one tests table lookup — precisely covering the two retrieval weaknesses the author describes.** **⑥ ⭐⭐⭐ Its argument for hybrid retrieval reads verbatim and names each retrieval type’s failure mode** — **the document types read verbatim as**: **"long contractual wording, exclusions and conditional clauses, tables and schedules, policy identifiers and exact reference numbers, similar clauses with materially different meanings, scanned or low-quality pages, domain-specific terminology across Motor, Travel, Home, Marine and Reinsurance documents"**; **and the two failure modes verbatim**: **"A normal keyword search may miss semantically similar wording. A dense-vector search may understand meaning but fail on exact policy IDs, codes or table values."** ⭐⭐ **Both "semantically similar but differently worded" and "identically worded but materially different in meaning" are listed as difficulties — the latter a risk peculiar to policy text** (**⚠️ the entry does not claim hybrid retrieval fully solves either — four misses remain by the author’s own account**). **⑦ ⭐⭐⭐ Its abstention and conservative generation are given their own evaluation scenarios, another landing point for this round’s theme** — **section 13 lists three examples verbatim**: **"Example — successful retrieval"**, **"Example — retrieval failure propagating downstream"** and **"Example — conservative generation under missing evidence"** ⭐⭐ **"How a retrieval failure propagates downstream" is treated as an evaluation scenario rather than an incident — the propagation of error is itself put under observation**; **generation evaluation is separate from retrieval evaluation and checks verbatim**: **"answer-status correctness, groundedness, answer correctness, citation correctness, unsupported claims, hallucination-free behavior"** (**⚠️ nothing was run, so no level of performance is claimed**). **⑧ ⭐⭐ Its ingestion and chunking strategies read verbatim and are staged**: **ingestion includes "Native extraction first", "Table-aware extraction", "Selective OCR strategy" and a "Phase-2 corpus"; chunking includes "Phase 1 — generic narrative chunking" and "Phase 2 — structure-aware chunking"** ⭐⭐ **The ordering — native extraction first, tables handled separately, OCR only when necessary — has the same shape as round 329’s [[reinsurance-treaty-agent]] and its regex-first, LLM-fallback design: progressing from cheap deterministic methods to expensive ones.** **⑨ ⭐⭐ Its load-test table reads verbatim and includes a row that is unfavourable to itself**: **"1 concurrent / 1 request: mean 116.38 s, throughput 0.0086 req/s"**;
